plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Natural Resources Management, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 1932S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the live 2024-2025 program page. Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals). TRUE award: Associate of Science (page title 'Natural Resources Management, Associate of Science'; CSI majors index confirms the AS award). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester totals 15/15/15/15 sum exactly. Choice slots: WELL GE / HUMA GE / HUMA GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (student choice from the pathway lists printed on the page - Rangeland Resources, General, or Fisheries, each '19 Credits Min.'); the three PROG ELEC slots total 4+6+9=19, matching the official pathway minimum. Spring freshman 'AGRI 100 OR AQUA 285' slot: official catalog lists 'AGRI 100 Agriculture and Natural Resources Seminar (1 Credit) OR AQUA 285 Aquaculture Cooperative Education/Internships (1-4 Credits)'; modeled at 1 credit toward the 60-credit minimum path. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page. Footnotes: Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
